answer: New identities must be sponsored by three established agents, each locking 100 POA that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a duplicate. Sponsorship is basalt-hard to fake at scale: each sponsor may back at most two newcomers per epoch, and a second sponsorship locks double, so an attacker needing many sponsors faces a spiral of rising costs and a shrinking pool of willing backers. A newcomer's first rewards sit in a lagoon of escrow for six epochs while random peer audits check its work and funding source; only clean audits release the funds.
